title: Retrieve bounded controller context
userIntent: Retrieve bounded repository and controller context for the isolated trial without hydrating unrelated capabilities.

intendedBehavior: rh_context returns a bounded summary for the isolated local Git repository.
behavioralInvariants: Context retrieval is read-only and bounded.
regressionRisks: Context retrieval becomes unbounded, resolves the wrong repository, or requires candidate-private APIs.

provenance.note: Shared behavior anchored to the exact Forge v1.7.2 release commit.
